about.headline: Content Solutions that Break Language Barriers.
about.description1: Solvimate operates at the crossroads of education, language, and AI — delivering expert translation, dubbing, transcription, and AI-ready data solutions that empower brands to connect authentically with global audiences.
about.description2: MSME registered and GST compliant, our multidisciplinary team of annotators, linguists, content writers, voice artists, and tech specialists brings precision and cultural depth to every project.
about.pillarsBody: Six core commitments guide our work — from the first brief to the final file.
about.pillar_accuracy_body: Every word, frame, and annotation is reviewed by expert linguists to ensure precision across all deliverables.
about.pillar_cultural_body: We adapt content for regional nuances, ensuring authentic experiences that resonate across diverse audiences.
about.pillar_speed_body: Structured workflows and dedicated project managers ensure tight deadlines are met without sacrificing quality.
about.pillar_transparency_body: No hidden costs. Clear, upfront quotes tailored to your project scope and timeline requirements.
about.pillar_ai_body: Our annotators produce high-quality labelled datasets ready to train and fine-tune your AI and ML models.
about.pillar_partnership_body: We invest in understanding your brand and build lasting relationships focused on your growth objectives.
about.sectorsBody: Comprehensive coverage across language, media, data, education, and technology domains.
about.sector_s1_desc: Document Translation, Website Localization, Cultural Adaptation — bridging language barriers globally.
about.sector_s2_desc: Film Dubbing, E-learning Voice-over, Commercial & Multi-speaker Synchronization.
about.sector_s3_desc: Audio & Video Transcription and Multi-speaker recording services with precision timestamps.
about.sector_s4_desc: Text Annotation, Image Labeling, Audio Annotation — powering AI and ML pipelines.
about.sector_s5_desc: K-12 Curriculum, Assessment Design, EdTech Content, Digital Learning modules.
about.sector_s6_desc: Platform Integration, Workflow Automation, Technical Support, Digital Infrastructure.
about.servicesBody: From a single document to a full multi-language media campaign — Solvimate handles every layer.
about.teamHeading: Work With World-Class Language & AI Specialists
about.teamBody: We're always looking for talented linguists, annotators, voice artists, content writers, and tech specialists to join our growing team. Freelance, project-based, and full-time opportunities available.
about.contactBody: Reach us directly through any of the channels below or fill in the contact form and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
about.growBody: From solo creators to large enterprises, our flexible, scalable approach ensures you always get the right support at the right time.
about.grow_g1_body: Expand into new markets with native-quality localization in 20+ languages.
about.grow_g2_body: A personal project manager and specialist team assigned to every engagement.
about.grow_g3_body: From solo creators to global enterprises — we scale seamlessly with your needs.
about.grow_g4_body: Multi-tier QA processes with senior review on every deliverable.
